editorial_decisions.decision: Count repeated prime factors: 36 requires two 2s and two 3s. Relative to this, 12 needs one additional 3 and 18 one additional 2. For LCD 120, 15 needs three additional 2s (multiplier 8) and 24 one additional 5. These are not cancellation steps.

Before addition/subtraction, source simplify means calculating products while retaining the common denominator. Only after the operation is the resulting fraction reduced by common factors. Bengali step labels make this order explicit.
The variables occur only in numerators; all denominators are fixed positive integers. Do not add a nonzero-variable restriction. Symbolic checks include zero.

Inspected actual pixels. The red 8s/5s in figure032-02 are newly introduced multipliers for the LCD, not factors being cancelled. Figure015's English annotation remains in the unchanged source pixels; the Bengali description explains its missing-factor markers. These are accessibility clarifications, not wrong-answer-image claims.

The displayed initial expression is −11/30+23/42. A MathML mrow without visible fences is a layout group, not an added pair of arithmetic parentheses. Verification follows the displayed operators/fences, correctly obtaining 19/105; the original MathML is unmodified.
